patient discount

Patients can receive various types of discounts, such as user-wise limit discounts and date-wise discounts. If a billing user has the privilege to give a discount, it can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. Additionally, if any date-wise discount is present for a patient against any service, that date-wise discount can also be applied.
